description: This file manages telemetry data collection, configuration, and reporting for the KeystoneJS project. It includes functions for collecting package versions, sending telemetry events, and handling user opt-in/out preferences.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs debug messages if the KEYSTONE_TELEMETRY_DEBUG environment variable is set to '1'.

methods.name: getTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and initializes the telemetry configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Provides default telemetry data if none exists.

methods.name: collectFieldCount
methods.description: Counts the number of fields by type in the provided lists.

methods.name: collectPackageVersions
methods.description: Collects versions of specific packages, handling missing packages gracefully.

methods.name: printNext
methods.description: Prints message indicating when telemetry data will be sent.

methods.name: printTelemetryStatus
methods.description: Displays current telemetry status and last sent dates.

methods.name: inform
methods.description: Informs the user about telemetry collection and updates the informedAt timestamp.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends telemetry data to the configured endpoint, for project or device events.

methods.name: sendProjectTelemetryEvent
methods.description: Sends telemetry data related to a specific project.

methods.name: sendDeviceTelemetryEvent
methods.description: Sends telemetry data related to the device.

methods.name: runTelemetry
methods.description: Main function to run telemetry collection and reporting, respecting environment conditions.
